description:
Find release notes and changelog history for a package. Default latest mode returns up to ten entries; source ordering may interleave maintained release lines. Pin registry:name@version for one release or @from..to for releases after from through to; omit limit except for latest or @..to. Selected releases without notes return hasChangelog:false; empty selections return no entries. Default text shows parsed statements with available classifications, including unassessed ones, in source order; changes filters them and all matching pages are retrieved. verbatim:true shows original notes and omit_bodies:true only the timeline; both skip classification and ignore changes. Preserve generated-from-commits labels and pending/unavailable status; generated statements are not publisher notes. Notes alone do not establish compatibility.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

body_lines.description: Deprecated text-only original-note preview cap (1-50); omit for statements. Ignored for JSON, omit_bodies:true, verbatim:true or verbose:true.

changes.description: Statements: actionable (MUST_ACT, including uncertain), important (actionable + SHOULD_KNOW), or all (default, including no impact identified, too-long and unassessed statements). Filters before pagination. Coverage includes every selected release. Ignored outside the default statement view.

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON includes full statement text and per-item provenance; verbatim:true returns original bodies instead.

limit.description: Do not send limit with @version, @from..to or @from..; those targets select the releases. Valid range call: {"target":"npm:express@4.21.2..5.2.1"}. Only latest or @..to accepts limit (1-50, default 10).

omit_bodies.description: Show only the version/date/URL timeline, skipping parsing and classification. Cannot combine with verbatim:true or verbose:true.

target.description: Latest: npm:express (no @ suffix). One release: npm:express@5.2.1. Range: npm:express@4.21.2..5.2.1. Never leave a trailing @. Ranges exclude from and include to: @4.21.2..5.2.1 returns releases after 4.21.2 through 5.2.1. Use @from alone for the starting release's own notes. Open bounds from.. and ..to are accepted. Package-only; repository and site targets are rejected. Registries: npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub.

verbatim.description: Show full original notes instead of parsed statements, including bodies in JSON. Skips classification. Cannot combine with omit_bodies:true.

verbose.description: Deprecated alias for verbatim:true in text and JSON; overrides body_lines; cannot combine with omit_bodies:true.

name: pkg_changelog
